bibliographic.title: The Black Ladder
bibliographic.author: Jan Åberg
bibliographic.description:
This is the first game in a series of four, called Werner's Quest. The games are parodies of Zork 1, 2, 3 and Enchanter respectively.

All the games are included in the downloadable archive.

The ZIL-version have built-in InvisiClues.

links.title: WernersQuest.zip
links.desc: This has a batch file menu which probably only works under Windows 95/98/ME.

links.title: Story File Archive
links.desc: An archive containing all four games in the series, in Zcode format as well as a Commodore 64 disk image.

links.title: Story File
links.desc: The game rewritten in ZIL for a more "modern" look. Very true to original.

links.title: Source
links.desc: Full source to the ZIL-version, The original C64 disk image and all reverse engineering files.
